segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func newExhaustNode(scene: SKScene) { guard let emitter = SKEmitterNode(fileNamed: "exhaust.sks") else { return } // Place the emitter at the rear of the ship. emitter.position = CGPoint(x: 0, y: -40) emitter.name = "exhaust" // Send the particles to the scene. emitter.targetNode = scene; scene.addChild(emitter) } ```
